title: Boutinot Limited
description:
[wine] Boutinot Limited — a privately held UK wine importer, distributor, and producer headquartered at Boundary House, Cheadle Point, Cheadle, Greater Manchester, operating since the 1980s under the Boutinot brand with subsidiaries including Boutinot USA Inc (US operations), and group companies In Vino Limited (holding company), In Vino Property Limited, with interests in Henners Ltd (Sussex wine producer) and Moreno Wines & Co. Ltd (London wine merchant). The company operates vineyards in France (Boutinot SAS / Domaine Boutinot) and South Africa, distributes to UK national retailers, and serves international markets including Canada (LCBO). Estimated annual revenue: £50–80 million; estimated 200–300 current employees. Auditor: Mazars LLP. Banking: HSBC (CBIL, overdraft facilities), Barclays (invoice financing).

The dataset comprises approximately 384 GB exfiltrated from a corporate file server, capturing the company's entire digital operational footprint across 10 top-level directories and approximately 100,000 files spanning 2006 to January 2026:

The Sage Payroll directory (9.7 GB) contains the complete payroll database for Boutinot Limited in PAYROLL.MDB (Microsoft Access / Jet DB format, confirmed via header verification) and PAYROLL.DAT (185,609 lines, confirmed via line count), covering every employee from 2006 to January 2026. The database contains National Insurance numbers, bank account details (sort code and account number), home addresses, dates of birth, salary and wage rates, PAYE tax codes, pension contributions, student loan deductions, and statutory pay records. 319+ employee document folders contain individual P60 annual tax summaries, P45 leaver certificates, payslips, and auto-enrolment pension assessment letters. 500+ SagePay backup snapshots provide point-in-time payroll state from every pay period across 20 years, and 21 year-end data files (YearEnd2006 through YearEnd20252026) preserve annual HMRC submission data. Payroll backups for two additional companies — Henners Ltd (1 backup, 105 MB) and Moreno Wines & Co. Ltd (3 backups, 105 MB each) — expose third-party employee NI numbers, bank details, and salaries. Mirrors of these payroll datasets also exist in E/Sage Payroll/.

The CTS directory (301 MB) contains acquisition documents for the CTS subsidiary including financial statements, audit requests, bank statements, AP/AR aging, inventory invoices, acquisition memoranda, and — critically — W-2 and 1099-NEC tax forms (21982249_W2_2021, 21982249_1099NEC_2021) containing US Social Security Numbers for CTS employees and contractors. The BoutinotUSA directory (283 MB) contains P&L and balance sheet data, tax filings, audit workbooks, payroll reports, and intercompany reconciliation for the US subsidiary.
